race.comment: WAHOOCHINO (3) is the one to beat fresh, with three trials since last racing and an autumn campaign that included a Listed J.C. Roberts Stakes assignment at Ascot. He was safely held there, but had genuine excuses around that campaign and owns enough 1400m form to make a strong return in Mdn grade. TEX 'N' CEE (8) is the obvious danger on consistency, with three seconds from three starts and jumping favourite ahead of a smart one last time out. Ticked the 1400m box though and can put it all together today. ROCKING IN VEGAS (1) brings the most seasoned profile, having finished within four lengths in a NMW1Y at Ascot after a narrow Bunbury second. Back in grade now and can put it all together. ENVY HER (14) resumes for a strong stable with two trials behind her; the wide draw and first try at 1400m are the questions, but her lightly raced profile gives her enough upside to make her a live danger. SEA OF GALILEE (2) can feature on the back of a handy first-up run.
